record.field: SELECT A as "Año", B as "CIIU", C as "Tipo de documento", D as "Número de documento", E as "Nombres y Apellidos o Razón Social", F as "Dirección", G as "Teléfono", H as "Email", I as "Código ciudad o municipio (codificación DANE)", J as "Código Departamento (codificación DANE)", K as "Concepto del pago o abono en cuenta", L as "Valor total ingreso bruto sin IVA", M as "Valor total de las devoluciones, rebajas y descuentos" FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT('Year' FROM aml.date) as A, rp.classification_id as B, CASE WHEN it.l10n_co_edi_code IS NOT NULL THEN it.l10n_co_edi_code ELSE it.dian_code END as C, rp.vat as D, rp.name as E, rp.street as F, rp.phone as G, rp.email as H, rcsc.dian_code as I, rcs.dian_code as J, mml.code as K, CASE WHEN mm.smaller_amount != 0.00 THEN CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END) > mm.smaller_amount THEN SUM(CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END) END ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'L' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END) END as L, CASE WHEN mm.smaller_amount != 0.00 THEN CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END) > mm.smaller_amount THEN SUM(CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END) END ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'M' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END) END as M FROM mag_media mm INNER JOIN mag_media_lines mml ON mml.magnetic_id = mm.id INNER JOIN mag_media_lines_concepts mmlc ON mmlc.line_id = mml.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT aammlcr.account_account_id as account_id, aammlcr.mag_media_lines_concepts_id as concept_id FROM account_account_mag_media_lines_concepts_rel aammlcr UNION ALL SELECT aaat.account_account_id as account_id, mmlcaat.concept_ids as concept_id FROM mag_media_lines_concepts_account_account_tag mmlcaat INNER JOIN account_account_tag aat ON aat.id = mmlcaat.tag_ids INNER JOIN account_account_account_tag aaat ON aaat.account_account_tag_id = aat.id ) as aa ON aa.concept_id = mmlc.id LEFT JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.account_id = aa.account_id AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mag_media_lines_concepts_journal_rel mmlcjr WHERE mmlcjr.concept_id = mmlc.id) OR aml.journal_id IN (SELECT journal_id FROM mag_media_lines_concepts_journal_rel WHERE concept_id = mmlc.id) ) LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = aml.partner_id LEFT JOIN l10n_latam_identification_type it ON it.id = rp.l10n_latam_identification_type_id LEFT JOIN res_city rcsc ON rcsc.id = rp.city_id LEFT JOIN res_country_state rcs ON rcs.id = rp.state_id WHERE mm.id = {id} AND aml.date BETWEEN '{date_from}' AND '{date_to}' AND aml.parent_state = 'posted' AND aml.company_id = {company_id} {city_filter} GROUP BY EXTRACT('Year' FROM aml.date), rp.classification_id, it.l10n_co_edi_code, it.dian_code, rp.vat, rp.name, rp.street, rp.phone, rp.email, rcsc.dian_code, mml.code, rcs.dian_code, mm.smaller_amount HAVING (mm.smaller_amount = 0) OR (mm.smaller_amount != 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END) > mm.smaller_amount) ) as datos;
